The WEF hosts annual meetings in Davos, Switzerland, as well as regional events around the world, and publishes reports and research on various topics related to global development and cooperation.

The International Monetary Fund (IMF) is an international organization that aims to promote global economic stability, growth, and development. It provides financial assistance to countries facing economic difficulties, conducts research on economic issues, and offers policy advice to member countries. The IMF works with governments, central banks, and other international organizations to address global economic challenges and support sustainable economic growth.
